_comment: Labeled queries for recall@10 (benchmark/sla.json: recall_at_10_min=0.70). One or two natural-language questions per benchmark/corpus.json triplet, each expecting cross-source citations (video + paper + deck) for that triplet's topic. `corpus_id` matches corpus.json's triplet `id` -- ids are assigned at registration time (yt_<youtube-id> is deterministic; doc_<uuid> is not), so component 9's bench.py resolves corpus_id -> actual source_id/video_id via the seeded manifest (component 10), or by matching citation title/uri against corpus.json. A query is scored correct if the top-10 citations include at least one hit per expected kind for that corpus_id.
